note: Manipulated copies of examples/transfer-worker.jsonl and the verdict a verifier must reach. Same format as testdata/streams/expected.json: findings lists the distinct (index, class) pairs in order of first occurrence, states and profile_states the expected state of every record; pubkey paths are relative to this file.

cases.description: Record 2, a failed job, was edited in the file to read status ok. Its content_hash and chain_hash were left alone, so both no longer match: hash_mismatch on record 2, invalid. Record 3 still links to the declared chain_hash, so it is valid.

Record 2 was edited the same way and then re-sealed: its hashes are recomputed and consistent, so it is valid on its own. Record 3 still carries the prev_hash of the original record 2, so the link from 3 to 2 fails: chain_break on record 3, invalid.

Record 2, the failed job, was deleted and record 3 re-sealed so that it links to record 1. Every hash and link checks out, but the record that links to seq 1 has seq 3: seq_mismatch on the record that is now at index 2, invalid.

The journal was signed with the TEST KEY. Record 2 was edited and records 2 and 3 were re-sealed, so every hash, link and seq checks out and verification without a key passes. The signatures were copied from the originals and cover the old chain_hash values: with the test public key, signature_invalid on records 2 and 3.

Record 2, the failed job, was deleted and nothing else changed. Record 3 links to the deleted record, which the journal does not have: seq_gap, state unknown. No record is provably invalid, so verification without --strict passes and reports one unknown record.
The same journal with strict verification: the unknown record fails it.

Record 2 was edited and its schema changed to trail.evidence/2, so that a verifier for trail.evidence/1 does not check it: outside_scope. Record 3 still links to the original record 2, which the chain therefore does not have: seq_gap, unknown. Without --strict the journal passes with one record outside the scope and one unknown.
The same journal with strict verification: it fails on both records.
